vo.en: Grab your tongue with two fingers and try to say: The weather is nice today.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part: you sound exactly like a toddler.

vo.en: Your brain loses the ability to coordinate your glottis and your tongue muscles simultaneously.

vo.en: It proves your motor cortex is hard-wired for specific mouth shapes that you can't override.

vo.en: Try it again and notice how your brain panics trying to find the letters.
